categories.main_business_segments: Sichuan Baicha Baidao Industrial Co., Ltd. (ChaPanda) operates primarily in the freshly-made tea drinks industry, focusing on the development, franchising, and operation of tea drink stores under the ChaPanda brand. The company’s business segments include the sale of goods and equipment (such as tea ingredients and store equipment), royalty and franchising income, and other related services including design and online operation support for franchisees.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages digitalization and automation in its operations, including intelligent milk tea machines, a core ordering system, and AI-powered store management and inspection tools. It also operates temperature-controlled storage and distribution hubs, and has invested in a production base for natural tea drinks to ensure quality and supply chain stability. Product development is supported by digital intelligence and a dedicated R&D center.
categories.primary_customers_markets: ChaPanda primarily serves franchisees who operate ChaPanda-branded tea drink stores, with end consumers being a broad demographic of tea drink buyers in China and select overseas markets. The company also supplies packaging materials to third-party purchasers and provides services to franchisees such as training, logistics, and marketing support.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s core market is mainland China, with a store network spanning first-tier to fourth-tier and below cities. Internationally, ChaPanda has expanded with stores in South Korea, Malaysia, Thailand, Australia, and Hong Kong, and is actively developing its overseas business and supply chain capabilities.
categories.supply_chain_position: ChaPanda operates primarily in the downstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on brand operation, product development, and direct supply of raw materials and equipment to franchisees. It also manages logistics and distribution, and has upstream integration through self-operated production bases for tea drinks and packaging materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include expanding its store network domestically and internationally, strengthening product R&D and innovation, enhancing digitalization and automation, and improving supply chain efficiency. R&D initiatives focus on healthier, lower-sugar tea drinks, digital product development, and intelligent store management systems.
categories.revenue_model: ChaPanda generates revenue mainly from the sale of goods and equipment to franchisees, royalty and franchising fees (including upfront and ongoing royalties), and other services such as design, online operations, and a limited number of self-operated stores. The majority of revenue is recognized at the point of sale, with some recurring income from royalties and training services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ChaPanda is positioned as a leading freshly-made tea drink brand in China, competing with other major tea drink chains and beverage brands in a highly competitive and rapidly evolving market. The company differentiates itself through its extensive franchise network, product innovation, and digitalization capabilities, but faces intense competition from both established and emerging tea drink brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of RMB4.92 billion, a decrease of 13.8% year-on-year, and a profit for the year of RMB480 million, down 58.3%. Despite the revenue and profit decline due to market competition and consumer shifts, the company maintains a strong cash position (RMB3.56 billion) and continues to expand its store network, indicating a focus on long-term growth and operational resilience.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ChaPanda emphasizes product innovation, quality, and a diverse portfolio of classic, seasonal, and regional tea drinks tailored to evolving consumer preferences for healthier options. The company’s value proposition includes strong franchisee support, efficient supply chain management, digital empowerment, and a robust brand presence, aiming to deliver a superior consumer experience and foster long-term franchise partnerships.
